questions.prompt: What does the async modifier allow in a method?
options: Run the method on a background thread
Use await to pause and resume
Make the method run in parallel
questions.explanation: async enables the await operator inside a method.
await unwraps Task<T> to its result T.

questions.prompt: Complete the line to await the call.
questions.explanation: await waits for the Task and returns its result.

questions.prompt: An async method returning no result has return type ______.
questions.template: An async method returning no result has return type ______.
questions.explanation: Use Task (not void) for async methods.

questions.prompt: Which call risks a deadlock and should be avoided in async code?
questions.explanation: .Result and .Wait() block the thread and can deadlock.

questions.prompt: Arrange the await lifecycle in order:
items: await waits for the Task to finish
questions.explanation: A Task is returned, awaited, then the caller resumes.

questions.prompt: Complete the code to wait 100ms, then print done.
hints: Pass the delay length in milliseconds, e.g. 100.
